title: Nanoplastic stress drives cyanobacterial secondary metabolism and taste-and-odor production
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00160B, Paper
Jia-Xin Liu, Meng-Xin Xu, Long-Hai Cao, Mei-Yan Liu, Xiao-Yu Liu, Jing-Ya Ma, Jian-Lu Duan, Zi-Han Lang, Xiao-Han Zhang, Shu-Guang Wang, Xian-Zheng Yuan, Fan-Ping Zhu
The convergence of nanoplastic pollution and cyanobacterial blooms presents a complex threat to aquatic ecosystems, yet the molecular mechanisms governing their interaction remain poorly understood.
